verdict.rationale: Entra's own docs describe an application gallery for SSO: vendors can request that SAML/OIDC-enabled apps be added to it. Integrated cloud apps can be managed right away, and provisioning connectors cover SaaS apps like Salesforce and ServiceNow. The evidence never documents the catalog's size or how fast setup is. Missing for 10: evidence of thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC integrations, documentation that gallery apps connect in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects

citations.quote: a SAML / OIDC enabled application to be added to the gallery for SSO
You can start managing access to your integrated cloud apps right away.
Common scenarios include provisioning a Microsoft Entra user into SaaS applications like Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and many more.
